prompts.text: What is the best party you have ever been to and what made it unforgettable?
Give a dramatic toast to the group as if receiving a lifetime achievement award.
What is the clumsiest thing you have ever done in front of a crowd?
Start a chant right now and lead the whole room until someone joins you.
What song is guaranteed to make you the life of any party once it plays?
Show off your best dance move and hold the pose for five seconds.
What is the most embarrassing thing you have said out loud at a party?
Take the next drink of water in the most extra way possible and sell it to the group.
Who in this room would survive the longest in a zombie apocalypse and why?
Do your best impression of the last person who spoke in the chat.
What is the most spontaneous thing you have ever done?
Create a quick rap about the group and perform at least four lines of it.
What is one thing you always do at parties that you hope nobody notices?
Name three famous people you would want at your dream party and explain why.
If you had to party with a fictional character, who would it be and what would you do?
Get the whole room to do a synchronized wave with you, starting right now.
